data.name: Bunny
data.gender_notes: Bunny is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A cute and playful name for a baby
data.long_meaning: The name Bunny is derived from the word rabbit, which refers to a small, long-eared mammal. In Christianity, the rabbit is sometimes associated with the resurrection of Jesus due to its ability to reproduce quickly and in large numbers. The name Bunny carries the meaning “A cute and playful name for a baby” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Bunny usually hope their child will grow to embody a cute and playful name for a baby and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Bunny carries a sense of renewal and rebirth, as well as a playful and joyful spirit. It can be seen as a reminder of the eternal nature of the soul and the promise of new life and growth.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bunny total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: בוני
in_hebrew.meaning: בוני הוא שם שפירושו בונה או יוצר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בוני הוא שם עברי שפירושו בונה או יוצר. הוא קשור למילה 'בנה' שפירושו לבנות או ליצור. השם בוני יכול להיות קשור לנושא של יצירה ובנייה, ויכול להיות מלווה במשמעות רוחנית של יצירתו של אלוהים או של האדם כבונה ויוצר.

in_greek.name: Μπάνι
in_greek.meaning: Μπάνι σημαίνει λαγουδάκι ή μικρό κουνέλι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μπάνι είναι ελληνικό και σημαίνει λαγουδάκι ή μικρό κουνέλι. Είναι πιθανόν να προέρχεται από την αγγλική λέξη 'bunny' που σημαίνει λαγουδάκι. Στην ελληνική γλώσσα, το όνομα Μπάνι μπορεί να συσχετίζεται με την έννοια της γλυκύτητας και της αθωότητας.

in_latin.name: Bunny

in_latin.long_meaning: The name Bunny is derived from the English word for a young rabbit. It may also be associated with the Latin term 'bunus' meaning good or dear. In Christian tradition, the name Bunny may symbolize innocence, gentleness, and affection.

in_english.name: Bunny

in_english.long_meaning: The name Bunny is of English origin, derived from the word for a young rabbit. It symbolizes innocence, gentleness, and affection. The name Bunny has been used in Christian tradition to signify a person with a kind and loving personality.

data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Bunny is chosen for its meaning “A cute and playful name for a baby” and the hope that the child embodies it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bunny: A playful representation of the gentle and resurrected Christ, symbolizing new life and the joyous spirit of rebirth.

historical_references.reference: The name Bunny has been used throughout Christian history by saints, scholars, and faithful believers who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bunny is commonly used as a nickname for children, a pet name for rabbits, and as a playful or affectionate nickname for adults. In modern times, the name has gained popularity on various platforms such as social media and gaming.
